improvement_candidates.proposal: Keep enough concurrently claimable generic candidates in finite BATCH waves to reduce zero-yield launches when specialized browser/HTTP candidates dominate the compact frontier.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Fewer fresh workers terminate before ownership while preserving capability fences and atomic claims.

exit_audit_v1.public_safe_summary: Fresh v3.30 BATCH worker beaconed successfully, then exhausted its two compatible allocator candidates through atomic CREATE_EXISTS collisions. Four remaining candidates required capabilities this runtime definitively lacks. No authority was obtained, so the worker persisted NO_ALLOCATION and closed with zero productive units rather than fabricating work.
